assessments.reason: Payment labels and checkout failure policy change; known payment values and commercial transitions remain compatible. The existing orders visual group covers the representative payment-label consumer; targeted failure-page E2E evidence covers the affected route outside the visual matrix.
assessments.consumers: types/order-summary/item.ts getPaymentStatusById feeds components/client-table/transaction/options.ts and customer order history. The explicit map preserves labels for numeric values 0-6 and rejects unknown values. Shared error types flow from orders new/restart/resume responses through useOrder and cartStore.previousCheckoutError into /checkout/fail; its fixed copy/actions and conservative unknown navigation pass desktop/mobile browser cases plus persisted unknown failure with an order ID. cartStore cart/product/optimistic/total behavior is unchanged, so storefront home/search/product/cart screenshots add no evidence for this error-only store change. Payments/checkout parsers feed finalization, compensation, cancellation, resume/restart and order payment-state reads; known state wire/persistence values stay unchanged, invalid states refuse side effects, and affected PostgreSQL replay/recovery tests cover these consumers. No shared layout/styles, catalog, product pricing or cart line rendering changes.

assessments.reason: Verification and issue-tracking tooling only; no storefront runtime changes.
assessments.consumers: scripts/verification-evidence.mjs is imported only by scripts/verify.mjs and its tests. verify.mjs is invoked by package scripts, CI and pre-push; select-visual-checks.mjs orchestrates developer verification. No Nuxt route/component/store/domain reads these modules, and they perform no application or provider state writes. Workflow/docs/tests do not change rendered application state. Browser screenshots are not evidence for this tooling change; receipt/classifier/real-hook tests verify its consumers.
